notes: release_date 2026-06-23 from the Seed blog index listing (article page itself prints no date). Page states 'For evaluation, we prioritize model performance in live workflows over static benchmark scores alone'; every score panel is an image, so all numeric values are vision-assisted transcriptions stored in notes only (goal.md 12.5). Rows backed by a named prose claim are verified with score_status not_extracted; chart-only rows are pending. Code Arena: Frontend is a third-party leaderboard (benchmark_owner_reported, rank 8 / 1539). Not converted into evidence rows because they are unnamed: the crowdsourced developer evaluation figure (Image 6) and its anonymized-model comparison. Charts also include in-house benchmarks (Doubao Multi-Turn Bench, SeedClawBench, CreativeWork, Image2FloorPlan, MSQA, Workspace Bench, Agent Startup Bench).
